feature_name: NSW Feasibility + AI Phone Sales Agent

strategic_objective.owner_question: What are we trying to achieve?
strategic_objective.answer: Increase profitable customer access and sales conversion while protecting the Seven Hills cost advantage.
sub_goals: Protect the low-cost Seven Hills NSW base until data proves a better option.
Improve customer access through parcel collection and AI phone support before taking on higher property cost.
Use actual CRM/ERP sales, margin, postcode, pickup, delivery and service data to decide whether Artarmon is justified.
Capture more phone enquiries and convert them into CRM leads, service jobs and quote opportunities.
Generate and measure growth, diversification, and cost-saving opportunities for Toby.
Use ElevenLabs and Twilio as a CRM phone gatekeeper that answers routine calls from approved knowledge and escalates calls that need a human.
non_goals: Do not automatically replace Seven Hills with Artarmon.
Do not create unapproved dangerous-goods collection flows.
Do not enable outbound AI calling or call recording by default.
Do not let AI commit spend, staffing, pricing, supplier, property, or customer-impacting policy decisions without approval.
Do not let the phone agent answer from unapproved or unknown-provenance sources.

ai_ally.name: Toby Growth and Cost Ally
ai_ally.purpose: Continuously generate, rank, and measure growth, diversification, and cost-saving opportunities for Toby's decisions.
ai_ally.decision_boundary: The ally prepares recommendations and decision material, but Toby or an approved human commits consequential decisions.

site_options.name: Artarmon micro-showroom / service intake
site_options.role: Small central showroom, service intake and curated pickup point

strengths: Very low Seven Hills rent compared with likely central Sydney alternatives.
Machine installs and service capability create differentiation.
weaknesses: Seven Hills may be less convenient for North Shore, CBD and Northern Beaches customers.
Reduced stock model could frustrate walk-in customers without clear stock status.
opportunities: Parcel collection pilot for eligible products.
AI phone agent for after-hours and overflow enquiry capture.
Artarmon micro-showroom if incremental contribution margin is proven.
threats: Higher Artarmon occupancy cost could erode profit.
Competitors already cover Sydney trade zones.
Dangerous goods and bulky products cannot be treated like standard parcels.

ai_phone_agent.first_message: Thanks for calling Carpet Cleaners Warehouse. I can help with product information, machine servicing, order pickup options and getting the right person to call you back. If this is urgent or you need a staff member, I can take the details and escalate it.
mandatory_guardrails: Do not pretend to be Toby or a CCW staff member.
Use approved CCW-owned knowledge and approved credible external sources only.
Escalate when source coverage, confidence, or permission is insufficient.
Store the triage outcome and source basis for handled calls where available.
Escalate pricing exceptions, complaints, warranty disputes, dangerous goods questions and complex service issues.
Do not record calls unless recording flag and consent workflow are enabled.
Do not run outbound AI campaigns unless outbound flag and compliance approvals are enabled.

acceptance_criteria: fresh database migrations recreate the add-on schema
saved feasibility items can be listed and reopened after refresh
growth diversification and cost-saving opportunities can be generated ranked measured and reopened
tagged claims and assumptions are stored as visible findings
refinements record and display parent lineage
finished feasibility statements can be exported as Markdown
phone gatekeeper calls store triage outcomes
AI-resolved calls are grounded in approved knowledge sources or escalated
outbound AI calling and call recording remain disabled by default
phone-agent-created CRM records link back to call session IDs
